sources.title: Do Spammers Dream of Electric Sheep? Characterizing the Prevalence of ...
sources.snippet: In this joint work between academic researchers and Barracuda Networks, we present the first large-scale study measuring AI-generated attacks in-the-wild. In particular, we focus on the use of LLMs by attackers to craft the text of malicious emails by analyzing a corpus of hundreds of thousands of real-world malicious emails detected by Barracuda.
